The results showed that perceived ease of use (PEOU) and perceived usefulness (PU) had a positive effect on the intention to use, while perceived risk (PR) and self-efficacy towards technology (SET) had no significant impact. This indicates that PEOU and PU are the determining factors, while PR and SET are not determining the taxpayer’s intention to use e-filing. The result also showed that PEOU, PR, and SET were moderated by technology experience (TE), while TE did not moderate PU. It is known that higher TE causes a weaker positive relationship in PEOU, while lower TE causes a stronger negative relationship in PR and SET. It is suggested that DJP make an interface more straightforward to understand new taxpayers or taxpayers with no tax background, provide free internet with stable connections, provide 24-hour customer service, and reduce server problems.

articleTitle: The Role of Subjective Knowledge, TikTok Usage, and Brand Image in Influencing Impulsive Buying Behavior on TikTok Shop
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The emergence of TikTok Shop in Indonesia has transformed the e-commerce landscape, blending social media and online shopping. This study aims to find out whether subjective knowledge, social media usage (in this term is TikTok usage), and brand image have a role in influencing impulsive consumer behavior on e-commerce platforms. In this research, Partial Least Squares-Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) is used for the interpretation and calculation of the gathered data. The results indicate that the presence of TikTok Shop has been shown to significantly influence consumer behavior in Indonesia. The positive and significant relationship between brand image and impulse buying behavior underscores its impact on consumer decision-making and the potential for repeat purchases. It underscores the need for marketers to focus on creating and maintaining a compelling brand identity to effectively engage with consumers and drive impulse purchases. At the same time, the findings highlight the importance of brand image in affecting consumer behavior in the digital age. As the dynamic interplay between social media, e-commerce, and consumer behavior continues to evolve, understanding these interrelationships will be vital for both academia and industry.

articleTitle: Implementing Technology to Develop Lecturer Competencies from a Human Resource Management Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Explore the implementation of technology in developing lecturer competencies, focusing on the perspective of human resource management in the digital education era. The research background reflects the rapid transformation in the educational paradigm that requires lecturers to adapt to the latest technology to improve the quality of learning. This research method involves surveys, interviews, and document analysis to identify challenges, opportunities, and strategies that emerge in human resource management related to lecturer competence in adopting technology. Issues expressed include skills mismatch, resistance to change, and the need for ongoing training. The research results provide an overview of effective human resource management strategies in increasing lecturer competency through technology training, leadership support, and technology integration in performance evaluation. The research conclusions highlight the important role of human resource management in creating an environment that supports the development of lecturers in the digital era, which in turn can improve the quality of higher education. These findings provide a foundation for human resource management policies and practices more adaptive to higher education institutions technological changes.

articleTitle: Modeling Of Student Graduation Prediction Using the Naive Bayes Classifier Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The background of this study emphasizes the significance of the graduation accuracy rate as a critical metric for evaluating the caliber of colleges and students. Ensuring accurate predictions of student graduation timelines is vital for university administration to maintain consistent graduation rates and uphold the quality of graduates. The objective was to develop a predictive model using the Naive Bayes classifier to forecast student graduation accurately. The method involved applying techniques such as Log-Probability, Handling Rare Data (Sparse Data), Efficient Implementation, and Laplace Smoothing to process the data. The dataset used in this research comprises student records from the year 2023, sourced from universities in Libya. The results indicate that the model successfully predicted that the number of students who passed (175) was significantly higher than those who failed (25), achieving a prediction accuracy of 94%. This high accuracy demonstrates the effectiveness of the Naive Bayes classifier in graduation prediction. The conclusion drawn from this study is that the Naive Bayes classifier approach is highly promising for forecasting student graduation outcomes, providing valuable insights for university administrations to implement timely interventions and improve overall graduation rates.

articleTitle: Evaluating Value at Risk in First-Layer Cryptocurrency Token Investments via Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This study investigates the Value at Risk (VaR) in cryptocurrency asset portfolios using the Monte Carlo Simulation method, a crucial metric for measuring potential financial losses. With the cryptocurrency market’s significant volatility, especially peaking in 2021, traditional predictive methods fall short in accurately assessing risk. By analyzing historical market movements and simulating thousands of potential future scenarios, this research focuses on first-layer coins, which are fundamental to the blockchain ecosystem. The findings demonstrate that Monte Carlo Simulation provides reliable VaR estimations, capturing the high volatility and unique characteristics of cryptocurrency markets. This method proves effective in generating significant price predictions and aiding individual decision-making processes. The study concludes that Monte Carlo Simulation is the most effective method for VaR estimation in cryptocurrencies, highlighting its role in enhancing financial literacy and developing robust trading strategies. Our aim is to educate the Indonesian and global community on these strategies, opening new opportunities and improving financial security during the global transition to blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Examining Customer Behavior for SMEs in Mobile Food Online Delivery (MFOD) Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This research explores the factors that influence customer behavior in the context of Mobile Food Online Delivery (MFOD) applications for Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs). The rapid growth of digital technology has transformed the food industry, making MFOD applications essential tools for SMEs to reach and engage customers. Understanding the determinants of user behavior in adopting and utilizing these platforms is crucial for SMEs to enhance their service offerings and competitiveness. This study investigates key factors such as perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, trust, social influence, and perceived risk, which affect users’ intentions to use MFOD applications. Data was collected using purposive sampling from 218 users in June 2024, with 215 participants actively using online food delivery applications. Statistical analysis was conducted using Smart-PLS 4 software, validating the research model and confirming the significance of 40 indicators. The findings emphasize the importance of perceived ease of use and trust in encouraging user adoption of MFOD applications. Additionally, the study highlights the strategic use of social media to address challenges unique to SMEs, suggesting practical implications for improving customer engagement and satisfaction. This research provides valuable insights for SMEs aiming to leverage digital platforms for enhanced service delivery and competitive advantage in the evolving digital landscape.

articleTitle: The Role of Policy Mix and Behavioral Intention to Increase Electric Vehicle Adoption in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The increasing focus on sustainability has made reducing motor vehicle emissions, a major contributor to pollution, a critical priority. Electric vehicle (EV) innovations are essential in this effort. This research aims to examine the factors influencing the adoption of electric vehicles in Indonesia, aligning with global sustainability goals and environmental concerns. A quantitative approach was employed, utilizing a questionnaire distributed to Indonesians who intend to own electric vehicles. The study tested nine hypotheses using Structural Equation Modeling - Partial Least Square (SEM-PLS). The analysis revealed that attitudes, subjective norms, and moral norms significantly influence the intention to adopt electric vehicles, while policy mix variables do not show a significant impact. Finding: Attitudes and subjective norms, as well as moral norms, were the most significant factors in influencing EV adoption intentions. This highlights the importance of psychological and social approaches in promoting EV adoption in Indonesia. This study provides new insights into the limited impact of policy mix variables on EV adoption in Indonesia, suggesting that socio-economic, cultural, and infrastructural factors play crucial roles. The findings underscore the need for tailored strategies that address these unique challenges to effectively promote EV adoption in the country.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Indonesian Nurse’s Caring Behaviors in Tokyo and Berastagi Elderly Homes
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This study presents a quantitative analysis of nurse performance and job stress among Indonesian nurses working in elderly care facilities in Tokyo and Berastagi. Using a comprehensive sampling technique, data were collected from 48 nurses in Tokyo and 49 in Berastagi in 2022. The Caring Behaviors Indonesian Nurse questionnaire was employed to evaluate variables such as Job Stress (JS), Nurse Performance (NP), and Location (L). Statistical analysis revealed that 60.4% of nurses in Tokyo exhibited very good performance compared to 100% in Berastagi, with significant locational differences (P Value = 0.000<0.05). This research highlights the impact of different environments on nurse performance, emphasizing the need for targeted interventions to manage job stress and enhance performance through technology-based solutions. The study’s findings suggest that technological innovations and improved healthcare systems can play a crucial role in optimizing nurse performance and reducing job stress. While the study is limited to specific settings, it provides a foundation for further research incorporating larger samples and diverse environments to develop comprehensive strategies for enhancing nurse performance through technology.

articleTitle: Web3 Adoption: Impact on Digital Industries
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Background in today’s digital age, the Web2 centralized model still dominates, presenting significant access, control, and innovation challenges. Web3, with its decentralized principles built on blockchain technology, offers a method to transition to a more open and innovative system, reducing dependence on large service providers and giving greater control to users. The objective of this research is to explore the impact of Web3 on digital industries, focusing on the financial sector through Decentralized Finance (DeFi), digital asset markets through Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs), and the gaming industry. Using a qualitative method involving an extensive literature review, phenomenological analysis of current data, and in-depth interviews with Web3 industry experts, the results reveal that Web3 adoption significantly impacts the digital industry by improving operations and security, facilitating innovation, and expanding access and capabilities in the global market. The main conclusion of this research is that it provides valuable insights into the impact of Web3 technologies on the digital industry and suggests policy formation to support the expansion of these technologies for a more inclusive digital future.

articleTitle: Workarounds Analysis in Report Making at A Rolling Stock Manufacturing Company
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The advent of technology and digitalization has brought about a significant transformation in the manufacturing industry, and ERP implementation needs adjustments in its use. Poor data quality and incomplete data hinder the optimal use of ERP. One of the main factors affecting data quality is the occurrence of workarounds, which are adaptive activities to overcome the limitations of ERP systems. The background of this research is focused on identifying workarounds in making production progress reports at Rolling Stock Manufacturing Companies. The method used is a case study with data collection through semi-structured interviews, document analysis, and field observations. The main objective is understanding how workarounds can benefit organizations by addressing data availability and consistency issues. The results showed that double recording, double checking, double data reporting, and mismatch tracking effectively resolve current data challenges. In conclusion, the implications of this study indicate that the implementation of workarounds in the Indonesian manufacturing industry can be an effective strategy to overcome data availability and consistency issues.

articleTitle: Optimizing Pulp Industry Sustainability: Lean Manufacturing and Circular Economy Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This study covers the influence of Lean Manufacturing (LM), Circular Economy (CE), and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) on sustainability in the pulp and paper industry and companies. Sustainability is a crucial aspect in the pulp and paper industry because it can have positive impacts on the surrounding environment. The objective is to identify the correlation between these practices and sustainability outcomes. A quantitative method was employed, collecting data from 150 employees in pulp and paper companies, analyzed using SmartPLS 3. The results indicate significant positive effects of CE and CSR on sustainability, while LM shows no significant impact. The findings highlight the importance of waste reduction and CSR initiatives in enhancing sustainability. This study’s novelty lies in revealing the limited effect of LM on sustainability within this sector, contrary to its established benefits in other industries. These insights provide a foundation for industry stakeholders to develop effective sustainability strategies.

articleTitle: AI-skin tone Features on Online Shopping to Women’s Casual Clothing Purchase Intentions
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Fashion transcends mere clothing, serving as a medium for expressing identity, lifestyle, and broader economic trends. The COVID-19 pandemic has accelerated the digitalization of fashion, prompting significant changes in consumer behavior and industry practices. This study aims to investigate the impact of digital platforms and technologies, such as e-marketplaces, AI skin tone applications, and Instagram Stories, on consumer interest in online purchasing of women’s casual fashion products. A purposively selected sample of 98 respondents was surveyed using a structured questionnaire. The data collected were analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with Smart PLS to identify significant factors influencing online purchase interest. The analysis revealed that e-marketplaces, AI skin tone applications, and Instagram Stories significantly influence consumers’ interest in purchasing women’s casual fashion products online. These findings highlight the importance of digital tools in shaping consumer preferences and driving online sales. The study concludes that the digitalization of fashion, facilitated by advanced technologies and social media platforms, plays a crucial role in enhancing consumer engagement and promoting online purchases. This shift not only reflects changing consumer behavior but also underscores the evolving landscape of the fashion industry in the digital age.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Prediction Accuracy in ARIMA and LSTM Algorithms for Agricultural Commodity Prices
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Rice is one of the most important crops in the world because more than 50% of the world’s population consumes this plant as a staple food. Predicting the price of rice is crucial due to its significant impact on inflation. It is expected that this rice price prediction can maintain the availability of rice in the coming period to overcome price fluctuations and help the government in taking the necessary policies. Many studies have been carried out using various time series algorithm methods. However, this study uniquely contributes by not only comparing the predictive accuracy of ARIMA and LSTM models but also by analyzing their computational efficiency and applicability in real-world scenarios. Unlike previous studies, our research highlights the specific conditions under which each model performs optimally, providing practical guidelines for model selection in rice price forecasting. The main objective of this article is to analyze the comparison of time series forecasting methods which produces the best predictions with respect to higher forecasting accuracy and lower forecasting errors. The main contribution of this research is conducting comparative analysis and empirical studies with the aim of investigating the performance of traditional forecasting methods and deep learning-based algorithms using rice price datasets sourced from food stations as a government instrument in controlling rice prices in DKI Jakarta which has a strategic function for food security. In DKI Jakarta and its surroundings and becomes a price reference for the national rice market. This research uses the ARIMA (8,2,1) method with Moving Average and LSTM. Based on the evaluation matrix for the ARIMA Model, each MAE is 6.41, MSE is 146.48, RMSE is 12.1, MAPE is 0.0004. For the LSTM Model, respectively, MAE is 28.92, MSE is 1325.80, RMSE is 36.4, MAPE is 0.9857. Based on the MAPE target, the ARIMA model with a value of 0.0004% has an excellent accuracy level.

articleTitle: Implementing Responsible Innovation Practices in Platform-Based Business Models
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving platform economy, companies face the dual challenge of adopting new technologies, encapsulated by the 8 key variable Technology Creation (TC), to enhance economic performance while concurrently navigating ethical dilemmas (ETD) that emerge as crucial obstacles. This research investigates the intricate interplay among Technology Creation, Social Media Marketing (SMS), Human Capital Conflict (HCC), Data User Conflict (DUC), Intra-firm Conflict (IRC), Inter-firm Conflict (INC), and their collective impact on firm performance (FPR). Utilizing the SmartPLS 4.0 version approach with 328 responses, the study aims to uncover strategies for optimizing technological utilization while addressing ethical considerations. By examining the relationships between these variables, the research provides valuable insights to empower companies in achieving a competitive advantage in the platform economy. The results contribute significantly to our understanding of how organizations can sustainably navigate the evolving economic landscape, balancing technological innovation, ethical principles, and superior firm performance through the lens of the BOMRC framework (Balancing Opportunities, Managing Risks, and Compliance).

articleTitle: Analyzing the Influence of Green Marketing on Sustainable Purchasing in Indonesia Using SEM
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The study examines the relationship between green marketing activities and sustainable development goals in Indonesia. The research employed partial least squares Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) using Smart-PLS 3.0 to test hypotheses with data collected from 149 green customers in Indonesia through retrospective surveys. The findings indicate that green marketing perceptions significantly influence consumers’ internal and external viewpoints, shaping their green purchase behaviours. This study aims to enhance SDG 12 by promoting responsibility for green products through sustainable consumption practices. It also contributes to SDG 9 by developing innovative green marketing strategies based on socio-demographic knowledge and combating greenwashing practices. Furthermore, the research addresses SDG 13 by encouraging eco-friendly product use to mitigate climate change issues in Indonesia. The study identifies problem gaps in local areas and emphasizes the importance of green education to preserve future generations. Additionally, the development programs, using quantitative methods, highlight the positive impact of green marketing on purchase behaviour despite challenges posed by environmental and socio-economic threats in Indonesia. This comprehensive analysis underscores the potential of green marketing to drive sustainable development and offers practical insights for stakeholders.

articleTitle: Assessing the Influence of Artificial Intelligence on Human Resource Management Practices
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This research investigates the contemporary impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on human resource management (HRM) practices. In the context of the rapidly evolving AI landscape, this study aims to comprehensively assess its transformative effects on HRM within current organizational and business frameworks. Utilizing a multi-faceted methodology, including a cross-sector survey of 235 participants, in-depth interviews with HR professionals, and extensive literature analysis, the research explores critical issues such as AI’s influence on recruitment processes, performance evaluations, and employee development strategies. The findings reveal that while AI has the potential to enhance HRM efficiency, it also introduces ethical considerations, data security challenges, and psychological implications for employees. The study advocates for a holistic approach to integrating AI into HRM practices, taking into account technical nuances, ethical dimensions, and prioritizing employee well-being. Practical implications emphasize the need for organizations to adopt balanced and adaptive policies to ensure the judicious use of AI in HRM, achieving optimal benefits while maintaining fairness and workforce welfare.

articleTitle: Leveraging Data Analytics to Understand Antenatal Visit Factors in Midwifery Care
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Antenatal care is crucial for ensuring healthy outcomes for both mothers and babies. This study leverages advanced data analytics to investigate factors influencing antenatal visits, including parity, knowledge, family income, and health protocol facilities, among pregnant women at Respectful Midwifery Care (RMC) in Depok City in 2022. The research employed a quantitative analytic method with a cross-sectional design, involving 81 respondents selected through accidental sampling. Data were collected via questionnaires and analyzed using SPSS IBM 26, highlighting significant correlations between antenatal visits and parity (p=0.000), knowledge (p=0.004), and family income (p=0.007). However, no significant relationship was found between health protocol facilities (p=0.294) and antenatal visits. The integration of data analytics provides a deeper understanding of these factors, offering insights for technological interventions to enhance antenatal care.

Index Terms: Pregnant Women In The Third Trimester

articleTitle: External Auditors’ Perceptions of the Use of Cloud Computing in the Remote Audit Process
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This study explores the perception of auditors regarding cloud computing in remote auditing. Using the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) approach, the study surveyed 103 external auditors from Non-Big Four Public Accounting Firms in DKI Jakarta. The results showed that perceived ease of use and usefulness of cloud computing significantly influence the intention to use it, which in turn influences the actual adoption of cloud computing in the remote audit process. The study provides empirical evidence of the factors influencing technology acceptance of cloud computing usage by auditors, suggesting that audit companies can enhance the efficacy and precision of remote audits by better implementing cloud computing solutions.

articleTitle: Digital Emotional Intelligence: Fostering Lifelong Learning in the Digital Age among Indonesian Zillenials (SDG 4 View)
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This study investigates the impact of digital emotional intelligence (DEI) on the achievement needs of Generation Z in Jakarta, with a focus on the interplay between digital self-awareness and digital relationship management. Utilizing a sample of 280 individuals, the method involves structural equation modelling to explore how digital relationship management mediates the relationship between digital self-awareness and the need for achievement. The objective is to highlight the necessity of integrating DEI into educational frameworks to support lifelong learning and personal development, aligning with Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG 4). Results reveal a significant positive correlation, suggesting that effective digital relationship management enhances achievement motivations by fostering better self-regulation and interpersonal interactions in digital environments. In conclusion, this research contributes to understanding DEI’s role in educational and organizational settings, emphasizing its importance in the digital age.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security and Privacy in Cloud Computing: Challenges and Solutions in the Digital Age
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The development of cloud computing offers significant benefits such as reduced operational costs, increased flexibility, and enhanced accessibility to technological resources. With the growing use of data driven by technological advancements and business expansion, organizations adopting cloud computing face various security and privacy challenges due to the involvement of sensitive data. This article aims to discuss the types of cloud computing deployment and services and examine critical security and privacy issues, including governance, data availability, data loss, data breaches, access control, data control, and the trust relationship between customers and service providers. A comprehensive review of existing literature and current practices is conducted to identify these challenges. Specific solutions are proposed for each identified issue to address these challenges effectively. The findings underscore the importance of continuously updating security strategies to protect data privacy. Therefore, it is imperative for organizations utilizing cloud services to adopt these strategies to safeguard their data privacy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Arabic Language Teaching through Artificial Intelligence: Assessing Effectiveness and Educational Implications
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This study investigates the impact of integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Arabic language teaching using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS software. Questionnaires from teachers and students at institutions using AI in Arabic instruction were analyzed to understand the relationships between AI usage, teacher training, student involvement, and learning outcomes. The primary goal is to assess AI’s influence on student learning, teacher effectiveness, and student engagement. Findings show that AI significantly improves student learning outcomes (path coefficient = 0.45, p <0.001). Teacher training enhances AI usage (path coefficient = 0.50, p <0.001) and directly boosts learning outcomes (path coefficient = 0.30, p <0.001). For example, a high school in Jakarta saw a 20% increase in test scores after implementing AI for Arabic grammar and speech. A university in Yogyakarta noted significant improvements in language understanding and usage through an AI tutoring system with real-time feedback (path coefficient = 0.35, p <0.001). These results emphasize the importance of teacher training and student engagement in AI-based teaching. AI enables more adaptive, interactive, and responsive learning environments, enhancing Arabic language teaching effectiveness. Investing in AI technologies, teacher development, and promoting student involvement is crucial for optimal learning outcomes. This study provides empirical evidence that AI integration significantly improves Arabic language education, offering guidance for institutions and policymakers in implementing effective technology strategies.

articleTitle: Enhancing E-Learning through Gamification: Increasing User Enjoyment and Learning Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: In the modern era, everything is digitalized and accordingly the education system is not updated to include the latest Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. This modernization of the education system has been brought through several phases, from conventional learning to online learning which is smart learning. In Indonesia, Gamified E-Learning still has a negative impact in remote areas due to the difficulty of accessing resources, especially those connected to IoT (Internet of Things), such as digital learning materials, learning videos, and online learning platforms. This can hinder their academic progress and prepare them for a future that is increasingly dependent on technology. Analyzing e-learning that implements gamification with Internet of Things (IoT) connection in the education sector in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Adoption of Renewable Energy Technology in Indonesia through an Extended TAM
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Renewable energy is crucial for addressing climate change and reducing reliance on fossil fuels; however, adoption in developing countries like Indonesia faces challenges. This study aims to examine the factors influencing renewable energy adoption in Indonesia, using the Expanded Technology Acceptance Model. Surveys were conducted across various sectors, with data analyzed using statistical and structural models. The study integrates cultural, regulatory, and economic factors. Key factors identified include environmental benefit perceptions, technology availability, regulatory barriers, government support, and economic aspects. Recommendations include creating supportive regulations, raising public awareness, fostering partnerships, improving infrastructure, and developing a skilled workforce. These strategies can enhance renewable energy adoption and contribute to a sustainable energy future in Indonesia. Policymakers should consider these factors to design effective strategies for promoting renewable energy technologies.

articleTitle: Analyzing Engineering Approaches in Agile Software Development A Systematic Study
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Agile methodologies have become a cornerstone in information system development, offering faster time-to-market for systems and applications. This research systematically reviews how requirement engineering (RE) processes are conducted in Agile software development, examining both traditional methods and emerging tools. A systematic literature review was conducted, analyzing various academic sources to identify prevalent practices and tools in Agile RE, focusing on methodologies such as interviews and tools like ARAM, OOSA, and Mind Mapping. The key findings indicate a strong preference for interviews as a primary method in Agile RE and significant integration of tools like ARAM, OOSA, and Mind Mapping, which facilitate the RE process in Agile environments. The study highlights the evolving nature of RE in Agile software development, showcasing a blend of traditional and innovative approaches, and provides valuable insights for practitioners aiming to optimize RE processes within Agile frameworks.

articleTitle: Optimizing E-Service Quality and User Experience to Enhance Customer Loyalty via Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: In the competitive landscape of e-commerce, understanding the determinants of customer loyalty is crucial for sustained success. This study examines the impact of Electronic Service Quality (E-Service Quality) and Electronic User Experience (E-User Experience) on Electronic Customer Satisfaction (E-Customer Satisfaction) and its subsequent effect on Electronic Customer Loyalty (E-Customer Loyalty) on the Tokopedia platform. Data were collected from Tokopedia users through a survey and analyzed using SmartPLS 4.0 software. The primary objective is to assess how E-Service Quality and E-User Experience contribute to E-Customer Satisfaction and, in turn, how this satisfaction influences customer loyalty. The findings indicate that E-Service Quality and E-User Experience significantly and positively impact E-Customer Satisfaction. Furthermore, E-Customer Satisfaction mediates the effects of E-Service Quality and E-User Experience on E-Customer Loyalty. The results underscore the importance of enhancing service quality and user experience to boost customer satisfaction and loyalty on e-commerce platforms. However, a gap still needs to be explored in exploring the long-term effects of these factors on customer retention, suggesting a need for further longitudinal studies to fully understand the dynamics of customer loyalty in the e-commerce industry.

articleTitle: Investigating the Mediation Effect of Environmental Protective Behaviors on Urban Air Quality Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This research advances our understanding of the complex relationship between environmental awareness, climate change recognition, protective behavior, and urban Environmental Quality (EQ). This study underscores the importance of environmental conservation by demonstrating the positive effects of climate-friendly and pro-environmental actions on improving EQ. These findings emphasize the need for educational institutions to play an essential role in fostering students’ environmental understanding and responsible practice, contributing to a sustainable future. Addressing the urgent problem of deteriorating urban EQ, this study offers a solution by promoting climate-friendly and pro-environmental behavior. By establishing the mediating role of protective action, this research uncovers new pathways for policymakers, educators, and urban planners to improve EQ. Innovative use of stratified sampling and advanced statistical modeling techniques ensures robust results. This research captures an important demographic ready to lead environmental initiatives by focusing on graduate students. Identifying pro-environmental behavior as a driver of EQ improvement significantly contributes to the field. In conclusion, this study underscores the importance of protective behavior in fostering a sustainable urban environment. By highlighting the linkages between environmental awareness, climate change recognition, and protective action, this study provides a comprehensive framework for promoting positive environmental change. These findings advocate for proactive higher education and urban planning strategies, pushing environmental sustainability discourse forward.

articleTitle: Harnessing Deep Learning for Accurate Climate Change Predictions
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Climate change poses significant challenges with potentially far-reaching consequences. Accurate prediction of climate change patterns is crucial for informed decision-making and proactive mitigation. This research presents a novel approach to climate change prediction using deep learning techniques. The study integrates deep learning algorithms with extensive climate datasets, including satellite imagery, historical weather records, oceanic data, and greenhouse gas concentrations, to model and forecast variables such as temperature, precipitation, and sea levels. The methodology leverages convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to capture complex spatial and temporal patterns. The deep learning models are trained on pre-processed datasets, employing advanced optimization techniques, transfer learning, and ensembling methods to enhance accuracy and robustness. The research also investigates model interpretability to gain insights into the driving factors behind climate change, aiding policymakers and scientists in developing targeted strategies. Results show that deep learning models outperform traditional statistical methods, demonstrating strong generalization across geographic regions and effectively capturing long-term climate trends and abrupt changes. The findings hold significant implications for climate science and policy formulation, offering new opportunities for informed decision-making and effective mitigation efforts. As the world faces urgent climate challenges, this study provides a valuable contribution to the scientific community and policymakers.

articleTitle: Determinants of Corporate Engagement with Indonesian Islamic Banks a SmartPLS Study
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This study explores the dynamics of decision-making among corporate clients engaging with Indonesia’s Islamic Bank, focusing on the substantial influence of these entities in expanding the market share for Islamic banks. The research aims to identify key factors shaping corporate decisions and formulate strategies to enhance corporate involvement in Islamic banking. Utilizing the SmartPLS methodology, the study examines variables influencing the decision criteria of Indonesian business clients opting for Islamic banking. A sample of 394 financial decision-makers (CEOs, CFOs, Heads of Finance, Vice Presidents of Finance, and GMs of Finance), comprising both Muslims and non-Muslims, was selected. Findings indicate a challenge in low knowledge among respondents, regardless of religious affiliation. Smart PLS analysis highlights service quality and compliance as pivotal factors influencing the reputation of Islamic banks. Reputation is identified as the sole factor directly impacting corporate decision-makers in transactions with these banks, with no positive impact observed from religion, knowledge, or corporate shareholders. The study concludes that strategic interventions by Islamic bank management are necessary. Targeted initiatives to improve compliance and service quality are essential to enhancing the overall reputation of Islamic banks in the Indonesian market.

articleTitle: Application of the Push-Pull-Mooring Model in Switching Intentions from Conventional to Digital Banking among Young Generations
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Digital transformation in the banking sector after the Covid-19 pandemic in Indonesia as a middle-income country in East Asia Pacific has accelerated with the emergence of digital banks. However, digital banks in Indonesia find it difficult to retain active users and end up generating users with low deposits. The purpose of this study is to identify the influence of push factors, pull factors, and mooring factors on switching intention to digital banks. The data collection method used is questionnaire which was distributed to 272 millennials and generation Z who use banking services in Indonesia, using convenience sampling technique. The data analysis method used is SEM-PLS (Structural Equation Modeling – Partial Least Square). The results of this study showed that all push factors from conventional banks do not affect switching intention, while five of the six pull factors from digital banks are proven to affect switching intention, and all mooring factors are proven to affect the customers’ switching intention. These findings highlight that digital banks should focus on enhancing the pull and mooring factors to attract and retain customers, emphasizing the importance of superior digital services and perceived value.

articleTitle: Assessing the Role of Environmental Awareness in Air Quality Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Air pollution is an increasingly concerning environmental issue in Indonesia due to the rise in industrial activities and rapid urban growth. This study aims to assess the role of environmental awareness in enhancing air quality, focusing on industrial activities and public involvement as mediating variables. The research gap addressed is the lack of understanding of how environmental awareness impacts air quality through environmentally friendly industrial practices and public participation. Utilizing Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) via SmartPLS, this study analyzes data collected from a diverse sample of respondents across various societal levels in Indonesia. The findings reveal that environmental awareness has a significant positive effect on air quality. Moreover, industrial activities and public involvement play crucial mediating roles in this relationship. The results suggest that higher levels of environmental awareness lead to better air quality by promoting sustainable industrial practices and encouraging public participation in environmental initiatives. The study’s implications are significant for policymakers, indicating that enhancing public environmental awareness and fostering green industrial practices are essential strategies for mitigating air pollution. Additionally, active public engagement in environmental monitoring and advocacy can further strengthen efforts to improve air quality. The novelty of this research lies in its comprehensive approach, integrating industrial activities and public involvement as mediators, providing new insights for effective and sustainable environmental policies in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Harnessing Big Data for Economic Transformation in a Digitalized World
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Air is essential to life and health, with oxygen (20.94%) and the ozone layer protecting against ultraviolet radiation. Depletion of oxygen reduces the ozone layer, increasing UV exposure. Good air quality is crucial for living organisms. In 2022, Indonesia’s PM 2.5 pollution ranked 26th worst globally, exceeding WHO standards, yet awareness and trust in air quality devices remain low. This study aims to implement and evaluate an AI-based machine learning system to predict the Air Quality Index (AQI) in healthcare services. Using Structural Equation Modeling with Partial Least Square analysis via SmartPLS 4.0, the research involves 120 participants and historical air quality data. Comparative analysis of machine learning algorithms assesses accuracy, robustness, and efficiency, highlighting their potential in forecasting AQI and its implications for public health and urban planning. The study demonstrates the effectiveness of these algorithms in predicting AQI, with a significant value of 0.874 for forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: Leveraging Data Analytics for Enhancing Customer Satisfaction in Fine Dining in Jakarta
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has significantly altered consumer behaviour and expectations in the fine dining sector, making it crucial for luxury restaurants to maintain and enhance customer satisfaction to drive word-of-mouth recommendations. This research aims to investigate the impact of critical stimuli—Food Quality, Hygiene, and Price on Customer Satisfaction in luxury restaurants in Jakarta during the new normal and to examine the relationship between Customer Satisfaction and Word-of-mouth Recommendations. Data was collected through an online questionnaire administered to 150 respondents using the convenience sampling method, and the collected data was analyzed using SmartPLS software to test reliability and validity and perform hypothesis testing through the Bootstrapping procedure. The findings indicate that among the five variables considered, Sensory Experience, Satiety Value, and Price significantly influence Customer Satisfaction. Hygienic hygiene was found to be insignificant but still showed a positive impact on customer satisfaction. Furthermore, customer satisfaction was significantly related to word-of-mouth recommendation and partially mediated the relationship between stimuli and word-of-mouth recommendation. This study highlights the critical factors influencing customer satisfaction in luxury restaurants. It underscores the importance of leveraging data analytics to understand and enhance customer experiences, helping restaurant managers implement targeted strategies to improve service quality and foster positive word-of-mouth, ultimately contributing to business success in the post-pandemic era.

articleTitle: User Interface Design’s Impact on Customer Satisfaction and Loyalty in SaaS E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This study aims to analyze the impact of user interface (UI) design on customer satisfaction and loyalty in SaaS e-commerce applications, using a quantitative approach to measure the perceptions of SaaS e-commerce application users and determine how visual aspects and interface functionality contribute to the user experience, with data analysis conducted using the Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) method, indicating that an intuitive and responsive interface design significantly influences increased customer satisfaction, which in turn strengthens their loyalty to the application; the study seeks to provide insights that developing an effective user interface is crucial for building long-term relationships with customers and reaffirms the importance of integrating good interface design in e-commerce application development strategies, and further suggests that incorporating user-centered design principles and continuously collecting user feedback can enhance the user experience, thereby allowing developers to create interfaces that not only attract users but also retain them, essential for e-commerce businesses aiming to improve user engagement and loyalty in a highly competitive market.

articleTitle: Smart CRM Enhances Customer Insight and Satisfaction in Urban Building Material Retail
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: In the modern era of technology, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems have become essential tools for efficiently managing client data and interactions. This study explores the influence of CRM deployment on customer knowledge and satisfaction in building material retail firms, aiming to fill a gap in understanding within this specific sector. Using qualitative research methods, including document analysis and interviews, the study gathers primary and secondary data to assess the impact of CRM practices. The findings indicate that even basic CRM methods, such as manually logging transactions and utilizing communication tools like WhatsApp, can significantly enhance customer awareness and satisfaction. This research provides valuable insights into optimizing CRM tactics in the building material retail context, demonstrating that effective CRM practices can improve customer relations and support business growth even without complex technical applications.

articleTitle: Integrated Guidelines for Enterprise Economic Security Enhancement Amid Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: As enterprises undergo rapid digital transformation, securing economic stability amidst evolving threats becomes increasingly complex. This paper introduces a set of integrated guidelines designed to enhance enterprise economic security in this dynamic environment. We systematically explore the interplay between digital advancements and economic security challenges, such as cyber threats, data breaches, and compliance issues. Our approach integrates advanced technological solutions with strategic organizational practices and comprehensive policy frameworks. By evaluating current security paradigms and proposing a holistic security model, we offer a roadmap for enterprises to safeguard their economic interests effectively. The guidelines are validated through real-world case studies and simulations, illustrating their practicality and efficacy in fortifying economic security. This research provides a valuable framework for enterprises aiming to balance digital innovation with robust economic protection.

articleTitle: Omnichannel Gen Z Experience Perspective and Its Impact on Online Shopping Intentions E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The rapid increase in information technology is supported by the COVID-19 phenomenon, which has limited interaction and increased use of technology that can reduce interaction, directly influencing the development of multichannel strategies to become integrated multichannel, namely omnichannel. This research uses a quantitative methodology, employing a survey research design and SMART PLS statistical analysis method. This research aims to determine the perspective of the omnichannel customer experience through innovation diffusion theory using perceived compatibility and perceived risk on omnichannel online shopping (e-commerce) intentions. We found that perceived compatibility and perceived risk of customers influence omnichannel online shopping intentions based on the constructs that affect them. We hope that this research can help design better omnichannel strategies.

articleTitle: Impact of Communication Technologies on Collaborative Learning in Healthcare Education
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Interprofessional Education (IPE) and Collaboration (IPC) play pivotal roles in fostering effective communication and teamwork among healthcare professionals. This study investigates the outcomes of interventions aimed at enhancing communication skills in an IPE/IPC setting using advanced communication technologies. Utilizing a pre-post design, 100 participants underwent IPE/IPC training, with evaluations conducted before and after the intervention. The research identified significant improvements in communication skills post-intervention, with average scores increasing from 57.57 to 62, confirmed by the Wilcoxon test (p=0.04). Furthermore, a literature review highlighted the importance of interprofessional communication skills in healthcare settings, emphasizing the need for clear, concise communication, active listening, and respect for diverse perspectives. Success factors in interprofessional communication included mutual respect, effective documentation, and collaboration among healthcare professionals. Our findings underscore the importance of enhancing interprofessional communication skills for delivering quality healthcare, improving patient outcomes, reducing errors, and fostering teamwork and collaboration. By sharing best practices and success stories, we can promote awareness and encourage the adoption of effective interprofessional communication strategies in healthcare education and practice. This research aligns with the IEEE’s scope by demonstrating the critical role of communication technologies in improving healthcare education and practice, ultimately contributing to better healthcare delivery and patient outcomes.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Coconut Quality Assessment Using GLCM and SVM for Automated Sorting
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Manual classification or sorting of coconuts, typically performed by visual inspection, is still prevalent among coconut collectors in Indragiri Hilir, Riau. This traditional method is time-consuming and inefficient, particularly for the industrial sector. This study proposes an AI-based image processing system employing the Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix (GLCM) for texture feature extraction and a Support Vector Machine (SVM) for classification to automate the quality assessment of coconuts from front-view images. The research follows the CRISP-DM methodology, a well-established data science framework. Four experiments were conducted to evaluate the system’s performance. The highest classification accuracy of 90% was achieved using cropping techniques without augmentation. In contrast, combining cropping and augmentation techniques resulted in the lowest accuracy of 60%. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in automating coconut quality classification, highlighting significant improvements over manual sorting methods.

articleTitle: Empowering Generation Z Digitally: The Role of Financial Literacy, Social Media, and Trust in Embracing Mobile Payment
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Advancements in mobile payment technology have significantly transformed lifestyles and business operations. Generation Z and social media play crucial roles in mobile payment adoption. This study aims to identify factors influencing Generation Z’s willingness to adopt mobile payments. Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) was used to analyze data from 257 respondents who are mobile payment and social media users in the Jabodetabek area. The findings indicate that Perceived Ease of Use, Social Media Platforms, and Trust significantly influence Behavioral Intention to adopt mobile payment services. Trust also serves as a crucial mediating factor in the adoption process among Generation Z. Additionally, the study reveals that enhancing trust and leveraging social media platforms can substantially increase mobile payment adoption among Generation Z. These insights are vital for mobile payment providers and policymakers to develop strategies that foster digital financial inclusion and promote sustainable economic practices.

articleTitle: Mobile-Apps Gender Equality Prototype to Improve Women’s Soft Skills
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The high level of gender inequality in the world of work poses serious challenges, especially regarding participation and career development between men and women. Data shows the comparison of the Labor Force Participation Rate (LFPR) between women and men in Indonesia. One of the factors causing the low level of labor force participation rate (LFPR)." for women in Indonesia is the existence of cultural norms that are still strong in most societies. By considering obstacles such as the low level of education among women, it is clear the impact that arises from gender inequality in the structure of society. As a result, women often experience limitations in accessing training and skills development, making it difficult for them to compete equally in the world of work. Awareness of the importance of transformational initiatives in changing the gender equality paradigm in the world of work is the key to producing a positive impact. By empowering women, a positive potential is opened that not only advances women individually but also makes a significant contribution to overall economic and social progress. Through understanding that transformational initiatives and skills can strengthen gender equality in the world of work, it is also necessary to emphasize the role of technology as a catalyst in achieving this goal. Increased use of technology has been key in providing solutions to gender equality challenges across various levels of Society. Research objectives: To improve women’s abilities through training provided in video form; To encourage the ability to discuss gender equality on certain topics through discussion forums; To increase access to equal employment opportunities for women through the Job Vacancy feature; To provide a consultation space regarding gender equality for a woman; To measure someone’s understanding by giving an interactive quiz. The online counselling development method can be carried out using the Rapid Application Development (RAD) method and the results can be tested using the black box testing method.

articleTitle: The Impact of Big Data Technology on Marketing Information Systems and Consumer Behavior
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This study investigates the influence of Big Data technology on marketing information systems and its effects on consumer behaviour. The background of this research is grounded in the increasing integration of advanced data analytics within business marketing strategies. The primary objective is to analyze the relationships between Brand Awareness, Purchase Intention, Word of Mouth, and Social Media and how Big Data technology modifies these dynamics. A quantitative approach was adopted, employing probability sampling to gather data through online questionnaires from 110 marketing professionals. Data analysis was conducted using SmartPLS 4 software. The results revealed significant insights: Brand Awareness strongly influences Purchase Intention, Word of Mouth significantly affects Brand Awareness, and Social Media positively impacts both Brand Awareness and Purchase Intention. However, utilizing big data technology showed no significant effect on brand awareness, but it did influence purchase intention and directly influenced Purchase Intention. Additionally, Word of Mouth did not affect Purchase Intention. The study concludes that Big Data technology is critical in shaping Purchase Intention, although its impact on Brand Awareness is limited. These findings underscore the importance of integrating Big Data analytics in marketing strategies to enhance consumer engagement and decision-making processes, aligning with the Sustainable Development Goals by promoting efficient and data-driven business practices.

articleTitle: Integrating Aspect Based Sentiment Analysis and SAW Decision Support System for Tourism Destination Recommendation in Central Java
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Tourism significantly contributes to the economic development of regions like Central Java, Indonesia. Therefore, innovative approaches are essential to enhance the tourist experience and provide destination recommendations that align with visitor preferences. Realizing this, researchers introduced an integrated model that combines rule-based sentiment analysis with a decision support system of the Simple Additive Weighting (SAW) method. We apply SAW to refine the recommendation system for choosing tourist destinations. This methodology uses online reviews of tourists for 10 destinations in Central Java. Using Aspect-based sentiment analysis, researchers categorize the sentiment expressed by tourists into 3A aspects, often referred to as Attractions, Amenities, Accessibility based on predetermined keywords related to the three main aspects of tourism. The results of the sum of criterion 3A and these sentiment subcriteria are then fed into the decision support system of the SAW method using Attraction, Amenity, Accessibility as the main criteria and positive, negative, and neutral sentiments as subcriteria. This integrated approach combines feedback from online traveler reviews based on the 3A concept with the SAW method providing a balanced and accurate recommendation system. The implementation of this integrated model demonstrates its good ability to generate user-focused destination recommendations. Where Lawangsewu is ranked number one with the highest weight, namely 0.5242 obtained from the weighting of the SAW decision support system method. Consistency in this ranking was tested by changing the weight by 5%, and after testing, the ranking order of tourism destinations did not change. Showing the potential of this research approach can be used as a reliable measuring tool in helping to recommend the selection of tourist attractions in Central Java.

articleTitle: Understanding M-Health Adoption in Indonesia and the Role of E-Health Literacy
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Mobile Health (M-Health) technology enhances healthcare accessibility and efficiency but faces challenges due to the lack of a real-time surveillance system for emergency responses. This study investigates the factors influencing M-Health acceptance among Indonesian citizens, specifically focusing on Behavioral Intention, Trust, Facilitating Conditions, Performance Expectancy, Social Influence, Effort Expectancy, Habit, Satisfaction, Usage Intention, and Usage Behavior. Data were collected from 216 respondents in Indonesia through purposive sampling in June 2024. Quantitative analysis was employed to evaluate the relationships between these variables. The findings reveal that Behavioral Intention, Effort Expectancy, and Social Influence do not significantly affect Satisfaction, while other factors show varying degrees of influence on M-Health acceptance. Understanding these dynamics is essential for developing effective strategies to enhance M-Health adoption and efficiency in Indonesia, ultimately improving healthcare outcomes and user satisfaction with M-Health services.

articleTitle: Development of an Analytical Dashboard for Enhancing Digital Data Performance Analysis of PT. Bintang Toedjoe
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The aim of this study is to enhance the digitalization data performance analysis at PT. Bintang Toedjoe by developing an analytical dashboard. Utilizing a quantitative methodology, this study measures performance analysis and evaluates the effectiveness of the developed dashboard. The ADDIE (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation) method was implemented, facilitating the transition from Google Spreadsheets to system databases and resulting in improved data management. The novelty of this study lies in the tailored development of an integrated analytical dashboard specific to the quality control department’s needs. Key findings include a reduction in report creation time by 35%, improvement in data processing efficiency by 40%, and enhancement in data accuracy by 25%. Regression analysis identified factors influencing performance, revealing that the dashboard improved the quality control department’s data management and analysis capabilities by 50%, leading to a 15% overall increase in operational efficiency and a 20% reduction in error rates. These results underscore the significant positive impact of the dashboard on the company’s data performance analysis.

articleTitle: A Fine-Tuned Large Language Model for Domain-Specific with Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT-3 and BERT have significantly shown advancement in natural language processing by providing robust tools for understanding and generating human languages. However, their broad but shallow knowledge across many domains often leads to less effective performance in domain-specific tasks, where detailed and special-ized knowledge is needed. To address this limitation, this paper investigates the effectiveness of fine-tuning LLMs for specific domains. The approach incorporates reinforcement learning to integrate user feedback, allowing the model to dynamically adjust and refine its responses. This will ensure the model adapts iteratively, improving communication and interaction with users. The fine-tuned model’s performance is evaluated using two domain-specific datasets—medical and dental. Evaluation metrics such as Levenshtein distance and cosine similarity are used to assess the textual accuracy and semantic relevance of the fine-tuned model. The results from the dental the medical datasets indicate a low level of textual differences and strong semantic alignment, respectively. These suggest that the fine-tuned model effectively processes and preserves the integrity of domain-specific content with the potential of fine-tuning LLMs to enhance their applicability in specific domains.

articleTitle: Integration of IoT and Blockchain Technologies for Enhancing Transparency and Efficiency in Indonesian Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The agricultural sector in Indonesia employs around 38.7 million people and contributes 14% to the nation’s GDP is crucial to the economy. However, it faces significant challenges related to data transparency, supply chain ineffisciences, and optimal nutrient management. This paper aims to explore the potential of advanced technologies, specifically the Internet of Things (IoT) and blockchain, to address these challenges and enhance the efficiency and productivity of the agricultural sector. We conducted a detailed examination through three case studies: the Smart Pest Management System for rice fields, Blockchain-enabled Traceability for coffee supply chains, and an IoT-based Soil Moisture and Nutrient Monitoring system for vegetable farms. These case studies illustrate the practical applications and benefits of these technologies in real-world agricultural settings. Our findings demonstrate that integrating IoT and blockchain technologies significantly improves data accessibility, security, transparency, and nutrient management. These enhancements lead to better decision-making processes, risk mitigation, and sustainable growth within the agricultural sector. The adoption of IoT and blockchain technologies presents a transformative opportunity for Indonesia’s agricultural industry. By overcoming existing challenges and unlocking new opportunities, these innovations can substantially boost efficiency and productivity, contributing to the nation’s economic development and advancing engineering practices.

Author Keywords: Smart Pest Management Agricultural Supply Chain Efficiency

articleTitle: Utilizing Artificial Intelligence to Analyze Technological Trends in Indonesia’s Mining and Quarrying Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Most of the natural resources in the mining and quarrying industry are non-renewable, presenting a unique dynamic that requires the industry to generate profit from these energy sources while also identifying alternatives as resources deplete. This research aims to identify current technology trends and analyze their implementation in the mining and quarrying industry. Using a descriptive qualitative research approach, secondary data was obtained through desk study techniques, employing five AI tools—ChatGPT, Jenni, Perplexity, Elicit, and Gemini—to analyze technologies such as Ubiquitous Computing, Internet of Things (IoT), Datafication, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Extended Reality, Blockchain, 3D Printing, Gene Editing, Nanotechnology, and New Energy Solutions. The study found that 80% of these technology trends are not yet widely implemented and require further research, with IoT being the most commonly adopted technology. These findings highlight the need for continued exploration and adaptation of emerging technologies in the industry.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Technological Integration in Human Resources Management During Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This research aims to explore the impact of technology adoption on Human Resources (HR) in the Industry 4.0 era, focusing on comparing technology implementation across various industrial sectors. The background of this study involves a significant transformation in the workplace, where technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, automation, and data analytics are becoming increasingly dominant. The research method employs a survey involving 150 respondents from the manufacturing, service, and information technology sectors, with data analyzed using SmartPLS 4.0 to obtain accurate and comprehensive results. The participant variables in this study include Perceived Ease of Use (PEU), Satisfaction (S), System Integration (SI), and Technology Trust (TT). The primary issue addressed is how technology adoption influences HR management strategies and whether there are significant differences between industrial sectors. The findings reveal substantial differences in technology adoption rates across different industries and their impact on crucial aspects such as recruitment, training, and employee performance. These results underscore the necessity for rapid adaptation in HR strategies to respond to technological changes, providing recommendations to enhance organizational adaptability in the Industry 4.0 era. This research offers in-depth insights into the challenges and opportunities faced by HR in dealing with technological transformation. Furthermore, it is a foundation for developing relevant and effective HR policies and practices in this dynamically changing era.

articleTitle: Analysis on User’s Attitude Towards Content Creation Using Artificial Intelligence in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: In the digital era, technology, especially Artificial Intelligence (AI), has significantly transformed the creative industry, particularly in content creation. AI enhances efficiency, accelerates production processes, and diversifies creativity in multimedia content development. However, understanding the attitudes of industry practitioners and consumers towards AI adoption in content creation is crucial. This study aims to investigate these attitudes and perceptions using the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). The research focuses on key factors such as perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, and their impact on attitudes toward AI-driven content creation. A comprehensive survey was conducted among industry practitioners and consumers to gather insights into their perspectives, concerns, and expectations regarding AI integration in creative practices. The findings indicate a generally positive perception of AI's usefulness in content creation, although concerns about authenticity and control persist. This study provides valuable insights for industry practitioners, decision-makers, and researchers, offering guidance on developing AI applications that are responsive to audience needs and expectations while addressing ethical, safety, and quality considerations. The results underscore the importance of fostering a balanced approach to AI adoption in content creation, ensuring it complements rather than replaces human creativity.

articleTitle: The Future Prospects of Big Data and Machine Learning Implementation in Financial Auditing
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The revolution of technologies affects the significant transformation of financial audit driven by the integration of artificial intelligence-based technology. The traditional methods of auditing are being redefined into modern auditing through the lens of automation. This modern audit engagement encompasses the application of big data and machine learning to assist auditors in managing diverse and massive volumes of data and identifying the occurrence of anomalies based on algorithms. Our research aims to investigate the impact of big data and machine learning implementation on the audit process and analyze the challenges and opportunities of the actual use of these technologies in various audit processes and will it change the role of auditors. This research is conducted with a descriptive qualitative method, in which we conduct a literature review on research papers published in various reputable databases. Furthermore, we distribute a qualitative survey questionnaire addressed to external auditors in Indonesia that implement big data and machine learning in carrying out the financial statement audit. The results show that incorporating big data and machine learning into audit practices raises potential challenges and opportunities. Although the future role of auditors will not be completely replaced, auditors must continuously adapt to the advancement of these technologies.

articleTitle: The Impact of Smart Contracts on Cyberpreneurship in Contemporary Business Marketing
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The rapid advancement of smart contract innovation in online commerce has initiated significant discussions on enhancing the effectiveness of digital transactions. This research investigates the complexities of smart contract innovation within Indonesia’s e-commerce landscape, focusing on issues such as inaccuracies and behaviors that could negatively impact buyers. The primary objective is to provide clarity on legal matters in Indonesia’s evolving legal and technological environment. Employing a normative juridical approach, the study analyzes current laws and regulations to ensure the protection of participants in online transactions. Furthermore, it explores the concept of Cyberpreneurship using internet media for business—aiming to identify new business opportunities and improve e-commerce outcomes. Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) is utilized to understand the relationships among variables related to smart contracts and e-commerce. The findings reveal that smart contract innovation (SCI) significantly affects cyberpreneurship (CP) with an estimated parameter of 0.45 (t-value = 4.50, p < 0.001). Legal certainty (LC) also significantly affects CP with an estimated parameter of 0.30 (t-value = 3.75, p < 0.001). Furthermore, CP has a positive and significant impact on e-commerce efficiency (EE) with an estimated parameter of 0.60 (t-value = 6.67, p < 0.001). These results indicate that smart contracts improve transaction speed, reduce costs, and ensure legal protection, thereby fostering a more secure and reliable e-commerce environment. This research aspires to contribute to the development and regulation of e-commerce in Indonesia and serve as a foundation for future studies. By addressing the legal and technological challenges, the study aims to provide recommendations for policymakers and business practitioners to enhance the adoption and implementation of smart contracts in e-commerce, ultimately contributing to a more robust and efficient digital economy.

articleTitle: Emotional Intelligence and Responsible Social Media Behavior
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The rapid development of today’s world has seen the pervasive use of social media platforms, which significantly affects human behavior. Emotional intelligence plays a crucial role in this context. It includes self-awareness, recognizing one’s own emotions, managing emotions, recognizing the emotions of others, and interacting effectively with others, thereby influencing how individuals navigate the digital world. Social media serves as a digital territory where various emotional signals are expressed through text, emojis, and interactions. This study aims to determine the impact of emotional intelligence on the responsible use of social media among students at Bina Nusantara University and its implications for achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly the Quality Education indicator. The findings reveal a positive correlation between self- awareness and social media usage. This suggests that the students in the study can recognize their emotions and understand their moods when using social media, which affects their behavior. The study underscores the importance of incorporating emotional intelligence development into educational programs to enhance awareness and promote responsible behavior in the use of digital media in the digital age.
